audience_events.description: Select which type of audience trigger events to send webhooks

batch_flush_duration.description: If Batch Events is selected, specify the duration in seconds to wait before sending a batch (when batch does not hit the batch size). If left empty, the default flush duration is 5 seconds. Maximum is 300 seconds.

batch_requests.description: Select to batch user events, and send as an array of events in the payload. Batches will be sent every 5 seconds or immediately when the batch size specified below is hit first

batch_size.description: If Batch Events is selected, specify the max number of user events to be sent in each batch. If left empty, the default batch size is 10

field_changes.description: Select up to 75 user fields to trigger user change events. For any user in the exported audience, if any of the selected field values change, then the user field change event will be sent to the webhook.

http_method.description: Select the HTTP method to use for the webhook request. If not provided, the default method is POST.

include_segs.description: Select to include the entity's audience membership as a field on the payload called 'segments_all'

withbackfill.description: Add users who already exist in the selected Lytics audience

worker_count.description: Set the max number simultaneous webhooks calls that can be handled at once (max 20)

day_of_week.description: Day of week to run work

end_date.description: Import Wistia activity data to this date. Please use the format yyyy-mm-dd, e.g. 2021-12-19

start_date.description: Import Wistia activity data from this date. Please use the format yyyy-mm-dd, e.g. 2021-01-25

audience_description.description: Description to be used for the audience in Yahoo

audience_name.description: Name to be used for the audience in Yahoo

email_field.description: Select the field containing the user's email — plain or SHA256-hashed; plain values are hashed before sending.

segment_id.description: Choose the audience of users to export to Yahoo

email.description: Select the field that contains a user's email. This is optional

fields.description: Select additional user fields to export

first_name.description: Select the field that contains a user's first name. This is optional

identifier.description: Select the field that contains a user's identifier

last_name.description: Select the field that contains a user's last name. This is optional

segment_id.description: The name of the audience that contains the users to export data from

withbackfill.description: Select this to immediately push users who currently exist in the selected Lytics audience. Deselecting will only push users as they leave or enter the audience

continuous_update.description: Select to continuously import Zendesk tickets and users

day_of_week.description: Day of week to run work

start_date.description: (Optional) Enter import start date. If no start date is provided, all tickets and users will be imported until today's date. Please use the format yyyy-mm-dd, e.g. 2021-01-25

email_field.description: Optional

first_name_field.description: Required if no "Full Name Field" provided

full_name_field.description: Select all fields below from somewhere other than Zendesk to add info to end-users if they're missing it

last_name_field.description: Required if no "Full Name Field" provided

segment_ids.description: This option allows the list of Lytics audiences exported to Zendesk to be limited to those selected here. If this is left blank, all audiences that a user is a member of will be exported to Zendesk

time_of_day.description: Time of day to start export each day

property.description: Property can be field type, mapping expression, etc.

diff.description: Diff will be empty if verb is "created" or "removed".

post.description:
Add a new Report Component to the Report. If the component already exists, it will be updated.
To create a new Component, you will need to specify the `type`, `name`, and `config` fields.
Depending on the Component type, you may need to specify additional fields in the `config` object.

For `size` components, you will need to specify the `segment_ids` field (`[]string`) in the `config` object.

For `composition` components, you will need to specify the `segment_ids` (`[]string`) field and a `field` (`string`) from the user schema in the `config` object.

For `overflow` components, you will need to specify the `segment_ids` (`[]string`) field in the `config` object.

For `dataflow` components, you will need to specify the `segment_ids` (`[]string`) field in the `config` object, as well as `show_providers`, `show_streams`, and `show_destinations` (`boolean`) options.
